subject: Update redis* to valkey* in server.c and module.c (#367)
reason: The change only renames 'redis-server' to 'valkey-server' in source comments (dict.c, kvstore.c, ziplist.c), a stderr usage-example string for --test-memory in server.c, and a log-notice string in tls.c. No command behaviour, reply, replication, persistence, or any other runtime semantics change, so there is nothing for a scenario to exercise.
